violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored So Do Not Hold Water (26 TAC §746.5013(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored So Do Not Hold Water
violation_type.typical_finding: Two inflatable pools were on the school age playground with water.

finding_variants.text: Two inflatable pools were on the school age playground with water.
A blue and white blow pool was observed on the playground. The pool current did not have air but had not been disinfected or properly stored.     A photograph was taken during the inspection.

A pool observed had a standing body of water that was accessible to children. The pool was not gated, and the remainder of the pool water was accessible to children while they were outside. The pool water was removed.
